decision: Retained an additive Workspace read and the original Resume response.
why: Existing strict clients must keep decoding their replies.

decision: Bounded Workspace admission without changing bot creation admission.
why: An existing aggregate snapshot test proved that the first limit changed old behavior.

decision: Compared the complete prior approval state under manager serialization.
why: A revoke between review and grant must invalidate that review.
result: Changed arguments, stale permission, and revoked reviews were refused.

decision: Used one paired actor and injected native protected storage.
why: The desktop and probe need one transport and different secret stores.
result: Actual manager and real macOS Keychain contract passed.

decision: Fenced sign-out admission and publication with the native generation.
why: A new request must not reopen authentication during cleanup.

decision: Used a separate bounded reader for native intent journals.
why: The secret-file reader rejects histories larger than 64 KiB.
result: A larger journal restored without device credentials on disk.

decision: Used native modal dialogs for trust and exact-action review.
why: The review must be visible and modal before the owner grants authority.

decision: Cleared local administration and paired access together on sign-out.
why: Signing out of the app must clear both protected views and native authorities.

decision: Parsed real native fixture snapshots with the renderer schema.
why: Separate mock shapes do not establish that the actual boundary agrees.
result: The actual native projection contract passed.

decision: Left production worker and configured remote route acceptance open.
why: Synthetic stop evidence does not prove a production process stopped.
